title: Wii VC H63 - Three-Point + Controller + Performance
tooltip: Patches only the original North American OoT Wii VC emulator.{0}Adds sharp live-GX three-point filtering, Test 10, ESS analog V3.3, GameCube/Wii rumble, corrected C3 batching, lazy depth conversion, and demand-armed depth snapshots.{0}Requires the clean NACE USA Wii VC WAD; the embedded N64 ROM is not independently modified.
